sources.detail: All 6 pages (raid + M+ x DPS/Healer/Tank) fetched live by curl with a browser UA, HTTP 200, 212-371 KB each. Parsed <table class="tier-list">: first <td> = tier letter, each tier-list-entry block's first img alt = "Spec Class" matched WHOLE against the roster. 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, each spec exactly once per page. Era-verified per <title>: raid DPS "Midnight (12.0.7)", raid tank "Patch 12.0.7 / Season 1", the other four "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight"; Devourer Demon Hunter present in both DPS lists — Season 1, no flip. THE RAID HEALER LIST WAS REBUILT UPSTREAM TODAY: its JSON-LD dateModified moved 2026-06-30 -> 2026-08-04T19:56:31+02:00 (the 12:31Z run of today saw the old page), and it carries 6 real moves — Holy Paladin B->S, Preservation Evoker A->S, Restoration Shaman B->A, Holy Priest B->A, Restoration Druid S->B, Mistweaver S->B. Those are the only source-level moves in this refresh and they produce 4 one-band consensus moves (all raid healers); 0 moves of >=2 bands, far inside the anomaly limits, and the page's own fresh date is the evidence this is upstream editorial movement rather than a parse artifact. The other five pages' dateModified are unchanged at 2026-06-30 / 2026-07-01 with zero moves. NOTE FOR THE OWNER (not a data problem): the refresh-tiers skill asks each page to store seasonVerified in sources.json, but the publish job's Gate 0 whitelists only the page `snapshot` key for agent edits, so writing seasonVerified would fail the night red. Era-verification was performed and is recorded here and in the skill log instead; reconciling the two needs a reviewed edit to nightly.yml.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) fetched live, HTTP 200, 221-357 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as the skill requires: every <title> reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)". 40 rated rows applied (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank) on the 7-band icyveins-ptr scale — S+/S/A+/A/B+/B/C all seen in the DPS list. NO TBDs REMAIN: Augmentation Evoker and Vengeance Demon Hunter are both placed in the page body and the string "TBD" no longer appears on any of the three pages, so nothing was written as an explicit null this run. ZERO tier moves against stored. The published-date watch item from the last three runs is CLOSED: the page's own JSON-LD dateModified now reads 2026-08-02 on all three pages, exactly matching the deterministic pre-agent published-evidence artifact (published-evidence/evidence.json, all three pages resolved 2026-08-02) and the value already stored in sources.json — so nothing needed re-storing and the gate has nothing to flag. 2 days old against the 9-day published threshold. Era-gated by construction: this source keeps its column and its projection input and never enters the live consensus.

Both pages fetched live by curl, HTTP 200 (165 KB M+ / 153 KB raid). 79 assignments (40 M+ + 39 raid), 0 unmatched roster rows, ZERO tier moves. Parsed by SPLITTING the document on the `<div class="tier__tier` marker (never matching between markers — the documented trap that silently drops each page's last tier) and reading data-original-title on each entry anchor. Vengeance DH remains absent from the raid list — the long-standing upstream omission, left absent rather than invented. M+ bands A/B/C, raid S/A/B/C. Era-verified: "Midnight" present on both pages, zero "Season 2" occurrences, Devourer present in both lists — Season 1. Method publishes no dateModified, so there is no page-self-date to read. The 8 non-roster M+ labels are dungeon names (Windrunner Spire, Pit of Saron, Magister's Terrace, Maisara Caverns, Seat of the Triumvirate, Nexus Point Xenas, Skyreach, Algeth'ar Academy) and were correctly discarded.

All 6 pages fetched live, HTTP 200, 80-315 KB, using the documented transport: plain curl with a UA alone is 403, curl with the FULL browser header set (UA + Accept + Accept-Language + sec-ch-ua/-mobile/-platform + Sec-Fetch-Dest/Mode/Site/User + Upgrade-Insecure-Requests, --compressed) returns raw HTML; r.jina.ai stays dead for wowhead.com/guide/*. Parsed the embedded WH.markup [tier-list=rows] block (tier-label + spec-badge slugs), which sidesteps the hyphenated "(S-Tier)" prose hazard. 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, 0 missing; the M+ DPS A+ band is present. Era-verified per title: all six read "Midnight Season 1", Devourer present in both DPS lists. ZERO tier moves. Page-own dateModified spans 2026-04-19 to 2026-06-25 per page, unchanged since the last run — these lists have not been rebuilt in weeks, so zero moves is upstream cadence, not a stalled fetch.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag in raw HTML (specTierListSection.tierLists): raid = the THROUGHPUT tierList, M+ = the SCORE tierList, never the default popularity grouping. 80 rows (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank per bracket), 0 unmatched icons, ZERO tier moves. Archon's own lastUpdated now reads 2026-08-04T12:00:00Z (it read 2026-08-03T12:00:00Z during the 12:31Z run today), i.e. today's daily aggregate has published and this fetch is of it. Era-verified from the page's own encounter list: the raid pool is Imperator / Vorasius / Salhadaar / Vaelgor & Ezzorak / Vanguard / Crown / Chimaerus / Belo'ren / Midnight Falls (the Season 1 raid, 373,222 parses) and the M+ pool is the Season 1 dungeon set (Algeth'ar Academy, Pit of Saron, Skyreach, ...), NOT the Season 2 PTR pool — no season flip.

Full re-fetch of all 9 Venomous-era raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, every one HTTP 200 with a parseable __NEXT_DATA__ blob and every encounter yielding all 40 specs. 680 tier rows re-derived and compared against data/encounter-tiers.json: ZERO of 680 moved, so the file is byte-identical afterwards and its asOf correctly stays 2026-08-04. That is consistent rather than suspicious — all 57 Archon pages carry the same lastUpdated 2026-08-04T12:00:00Z aggregate that the 12:31Z run already ingested, so a second run against the same daily publish is expected to reproduce it exactly.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages: 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40 rows, 0 unmatched, merged via apply-metrics.mjs survivability key, asOf 2026-08-04. TWO tier changes vs stored: Destruction Warlock A->B and Outlaw Rogue A->B. Both are single-band and survivability is display-only (drawer Source ratings box) — it feeds no consensus and no projection.

Re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList): "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" = 33 rows, value = the dps column, n = parses. Kept to the stored convention of DPS + tank specs only — the raid healer page also exposes a dps column and ingesting it would silently widen the series to 40; healers publish under the HPS name instead. ZERO values moved this run. Unlike the 12:31Z run (which saw values move under a stale 08-03 label), the label has now caught up to 2026-08-04T12:00:00Z and the numbers underneath match what that run stored — the same daily aggregate read twice, which is the expected outcome, not a stalled fetch.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages' specRankingsSection score column = 40/40 specs with n = parses, asOf 2026-08-04. Zero values moved; the M+ aggregate is integer-valued and coarse, and this is a re-read of the same daily publish.

80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+) parsed from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100, rounded to the stored 1-decimal convention, asOf 2026-08-04. Zero values moved at that precision — same daily aggregate as archon-metrics/-hps/-mplus-score.

Fetched via the JSON API only, never the stale HTML prerender: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json + /rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, both HTTP 200 on plain curl. 44 blocks; whitelisted categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField "lowerBound" + keyRange undefined = 3 blocks / 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched. PARTIAL because asOf must be the source's own snapshotDate and that is STILL 2026-07-28 (7 days behind, 8th consecutive day; manifest.completedAt likewise unchanged at 2026-07-28T22:06:44.110Z, and the manifest.json object's HTTP Last-Modified is 28 Jul 2026 22:06:45 GMT). NEW AND WORTH A HUMAN'S EYES: the RANKINGS object was re-published TODAY — its Last-Modified reads 04 Aug 2026 19:18:33 GMT — and every one of the 40 lowerBound values moved (e.g. Guardian Druid 388.37 -> 394.32, Shadow Priest 341.82 -> 348.24, Windwalker Monk 335.74 -> 344.99; +1-3% roughly across the board, no re-ranking of note). So the numbers are fresh while the snapshotDate that stamps them is frozen — the manifest step of their pipeline is not running. The new values are ingested (they are what the source publishes today) but stored under the source's own 2026-07-28 date, which is why this cannot be claimed as success. Confirmed non-cacheing: a cache-busted re-fetch returned byte-identical values. ESCALATION UNCHANGED: maxAgeDays is 8, so this key alarms on 2026-08-06 if snapshotDate does not advance; a human should decide between raising the threshold and accepting the alert.

This agent holds NO Warcraft Logs credentials and fetched nothing from warcraftlogs.com by any means. Its only WCL input is wcl-fetch/evidence.json, written by the deterministic pre-agent step at 2026-08-04T22:40:25.972Z: verdict "rdps-broken" — characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 returned HTTP 200 with a bare "Internal server error" and 0 rankings, so the whole redistributed-credit metric family is still broken upstream. OAuth and GraphQL transport both report ok (rate limit 3600/h, 1 point spent), which isolates the fault to the rdps metric family exactly as documented. evidence.landed carries no entry for this key, so the zone-46 Mythic medians could not honestly land and the 47 stored rows were LEFT UNTOUCHED at 2026-08-04 (0 days old against maxAgeDays 10 — they were refreshed by a residential-IP run earlier, which can reach the HTML statistics endpoint that CI cannot).

Same cause as wcl-live-raid: no credentials held by this agent, no warcraftlogs.com fetch attempted, and wcl-fetch/evidence.json (verdict "rdps-broken", attempted 2026-08-04T22:40:25.972Z) lists no landed rows for this key. The 40 zone-47 M+ median rows were left unchanged at 2026-08-04.
